name: Lior's Mother
source: Lior's Mother has abandoned her son a long time ago. She only gave him a bit of money after his grandmother died. [spoiler]After giving birth to Lior, she offered his sould to Lucifer in exchange for eternal youth, wealth and power.[/spoiler]
